join: normalised port name and coordinates within 25 km (NGA WPI United States port vs NOAA Coast Pilot GNIS-tagged place)
method: Each pair checked by reading both records: WPI name, alternate names, coordinates, region and cited publication against the Coast Pilot place name, GNIS class, state, coordinates and the paragraph text. 'correct' means the paragraph describes the same port or harbour as the WPI row; a paragraph about a neighbouring landform or a different basin of the same town is 'wrong'.

pairs.reason: Same town, but the Coast Pilot paragraph describes the Montauk village waterfront at the southeast end of the bay (Fort Pond Bay, commercial pier), not Montauk Harbor (Lake Montauk) 3.9 km east where the WPI point sits; a different harbour entry is needed.
